about.title: A calm, clean space made for you
about.text:
Velvet Touch started in 2016 with one chair and one promise: every client leaves feeling special. Today our team of 6 stylists serves families across Jhusi and Prayagraj.

We use branded products, sterilise every tool after each client, and always tell you the price before we start.

services.name: Hair Colour & Highlights

services.name: Hair Spa & Keratin

services.name: Facial & Clean-up
